description: This Java class 'DefaultPubSubConfig' implements the 'PubSubConfig' interface, providing configuration handling for a pubsub system. It reads configuration parameters such as seed, hash family size, restart delay, update interval, and force update probability from a configuration source, with methods for accessing these values and standard object methods like equals, hashCode, and toString.

classes.name: DefaultPubSubConfig
classes.description: Immutable implementation of the PubSubConfig interface, encapsulating pubsub configuration parameters for the system.

methods.name: getSeed
methods.description: Returns the seed string used in pubsub configuration.

methods.name: getHashFamilySize
methods.description: Returns the hash family size used in pubsub configuration.

methods.name: getRestartDelay
methods.description: Returns the restart delay duration for pubsub system.

methods.name: getForceUpdateProbability
methods.description: Returns the probability of a forced update.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of PubSubConfig from a Config object.
